Title: Heel Pain Isn't Just From Standing - It Happens While You Sleep Too

Description:
Your plantar fascia heals overnight in a shortened position, and three everyday habits pile more strain on top of that: ramping up activity too fast, wearing cushionless shoes on hard floors, and skipping a stretch before your first step out of bed. Each one has a simple fix.
